requirements.text: AUTHORIZATION: the owner authorizes the FIRST bounded supervised-auto product-task validation run. The supervisor may make one small, pure utility change to real product code in a fresh, separate, contained worker session.
requirements.required_evidence: the supervisor start --json payload showing a real claude-opus-4-8 worker cycle in supervised mode
requirements.status_reason: captured verbatim on owner instruction; a bounded validation run, verified at completion (producer != verifier)

requirements.text: SCOPE (deliverable): the task is exactly to add a pure pluralize(count, singular, plural?) helper to apps/web/src/lib/format.ts plus unit tests in apps/web/src/lib/__tests__/format.test.ts. The worker's allowed_paths are limited to those two files; no other path may be touched.
requirements.required_harness: cd apps/web && npm test && npm run typecheck
requirements.required_evidence: the produced diff confined to the two named files

requirements.text: MODE / GATE (hold): the run is supervised mode with owner-gated forwards. Nothing commits, pushes, or merges without explicit owner approval bound to the exact prompt digest. The loop holds at WAIT_FOR_OWNER on every forward.
requirements.required_evidence: start --json shows supervised mode; no forward without owner approval

requirements.text: NO AUTO-MERGE (prohibition): this validation run does not merge to main. Any merge of the produced change requires the normal ledger controlled-task gates (G-gates + independent review + accept) as a separate follow-up, not this run.
requirements.required_evidence: no merge to main occurs as part of this run

requirements.text: SCOPE BOUND (prohibition): this is a one-off bounded owner-typed per-tier authorization for validation. It does NOT activate standing limited-auto / unattended product autonomy, and does NOT alter R348 (R595 lifts only the turnover auto-launch channel) or any other active hold (M0-T036 activation prerequisites remain in force).
requirements.required_evidence: no other hold moved; limited-auto remains refused

requirements.text: NEW SESSION (deliverable): the work runs in a fresh, separate, contained worker session spawned by the supervisor (a new claude-opus-4-8 process), not in the orchestrator's interactive session.
requirements.required_evidence: start --json shows a spawned worker with its own session id, job_object contained

requirements.text: RETURN (return-item): report back to the owner the run result -- the worker outcome, the Codex review, the produced change (diff), whether it stopped at the approval gate, and the test/typecheck result.
requirements.required_evidence: the in-session return summarizing the run
